messages:
Alyssa (People Ops): Heads up — SF hub (101 Townsend) just had a partial power outage around 14:12 PT. Building on generator; some systems limited. Please read and RT if you're on site.

Matt R (Facilities): Confirmed. Lost main feed; generator engaged at 14:12. Elevators are operating under emergency mode (limited cycles). HVAC reduced. We're on the phone with building ops.

Jordan (Office Admin): If you're planning to come in tonight, please work from home if possible. If you're already onsite, check in at reception — security is coordinating.

security-team: Lobby open but some badge readers are flaky — if badge fails, sign in at main desk. Security escort available for staff requiring stairs.

people-ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-0345 — "SF partial power". Pager: @facilities. https://status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-2026-0345

Alyssa (People Ops): Travel guidance: if your commute is >45m or uses assisted mobility/elevator access, WFH is recommended. We're covering parking or rideshare home for folks who need it. Submit receipts with expense tag `sf-incident-2026`.

Jordan (Office Admin): Hotel block: 12 rooms reserved at Hotel Zephyr (5-min walk). DM me with 'hotel' if you need a room; must confirm by 17:00 PT.

Matt R (Facilities): Kitchen sinks/hot water on reduced power; no hot water. Coffee station on generator but throughput limited. Bring water/extra battery if you're staying.

Jordan (Office Admin): Tonight's team dinner is canceled; calendar invites updated and refunds processed where applicable. If you had special dietary accommodation, DM me.

Ren (Engineering): On 6th floor, lights flickering. Laptop at 40% — any chargers/loaners?

Alyssa (People Ops): We set up a charger + battery bank station by reception. First-come, first-served. If you need overnight accommodation or reimbursement, file expense with `sf-incident-2026` and tag it; DM me for urgent exceptions.

Matt R (Facilities): ETA from electrical vendor ~ 90–120m. We'll post updates to the channel and the incident page.

Elena (CEO): Huge thanks to Facilities and Security for moving fast. Everyone please prioritize safety. If you need help getting home, reach out here or ping me directly. :heart:

Ren (Engineering): Thanks — heading out now. Safe everyone.

Alyssa (People Ops): We'll keep updates in this thread. If you see any hazards (smoke, sparking, water), call 911 first then ping Facilities. Thank you.
